properties.name: Olympus Mons Summit & Escarpment
pros: Above most global dust storm layers
Potential volcanic lava tubes on lower flanks
risks: Extreme altitude (+21.2 km) — near-vacuum atmosphere makes parachute/retropropulsion landing nearly impossible
Severe cosmic and solar radiation exposure due to thin air column
8 km peripheral cliff escarpment and bone-dry volcanic terrain

properties.name: Valles Marineris Canyon Walls (Coprates Chasma)
pros: Deep canyon floor (-4 to -7 km) has the highest atmospheric pressure on Mars
Exposed geological strata and seasonal recurring slope lineae
risks: Catastrophic landslide zones and 7 km steep canyon walls
Severe turbulent canyon winds (katabatic downdrafts) during entry
Canyon walls block horizon communications and early/late sunlight
resources: Dense CO2 atmosphere at canyon floor
Exposed hydrated sulfate deposits in chasm walls

properties.name: Hellas Basin Dust Storm Corridor
pros: Lowest elevation on Mars (-7.1 km) with highest atmospheric pressure (~11.5 mbar)
risks: Primary birthplace of planet-encircling Martian dust storms
Weeks of near-zero solar visibility during southern spring/summer storms
High wind gusts and severe electrostatic dust fouling
resources: Deep basin glacial remnants on crater rim
